subject: FY24 Departmental Budget Reviews
overview: The City Council Committee of the Whole reviewed proposed FY24 departmental budgets, hearing presentations and questioning department heads. No formal budget votes or appropriations were taken.

items.title: Information Technology Budget
items.summary: Director Rich Lane presented the $377,751 IT budget, outlining basic operational needs and discussing hardware modernization, cybersecurity, and shared-services models.

items.title: Building and Code Enforcement Budget
items.summary: Building Commissioner Bill Forte presented the $1,885,531 budget, discussed a code enforcement task force, and proposed raising commercial building permit fees to $22 per thousand.

items.title: Department of Public Works Budget
items.summary: Commissioner Tim McGivern presented the $16,358,149 DPW budget, addressing street paving, sidewalk backlogs, asset management, trash contract costs, and urban forestry initiatives.

items.title: Facilities Division and Chevalier Theatre
items.summary: Facilities Director Paul Righi detailed increases in utility costs and ongoing efforts to develop a five-year deferred maintenance plan across city facilities, including the Chevalier Theatre.

items.title: Fire Department Budget
items.summary: Chief John Freedman presented the $14,399,581 budget while union representatives and councilors raised concerns regarding staffing shortages, academy delays, expiring turnout gear, and funding for operations.

items.title: Health Department Budget
items.summary: Director MaryAnn O'Connor reviewed the $784,702 budget alongside grant- and ARPA-funded positions, highlighting social services, the community liaison program, and rodent control strategies.

items.title: Parking Department Budget
items.summary: Director Faye Morrison reviewed the $1,006,916 budget, noting staffing vacancies and unfunded enforcement positions while councilors discussed parking revenue accounting.

items.title: Civil Defense Budget
items.summary: Director O'Connor reported that the $9,390 Civil Defense budget remains essentially unchanged, with emergency management and multi-hazard mitigation plan updates supported by ARPA funds.

items.title: Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Budget
items.summary: Director Frances Nwajei presented the $107,996 DEI budget, reviewing ADA compliance work, language access initiatives, and the workload challenges of running a one-person department.

items.title: Recreation Department Budget
items.summary: Director Kevin Bailey outlined the $608,535 budget, detailing field trip expansions, pickleball court planning, after-school program logistics, and summer operations at LoConte Rink.

items.title: Workers' Compensation, Insurance, and Pensions
items.summary: Finance Director Bob Dickinson reviewed projections for workers' compensation ($600,000), health insurance ($25,500,000), and fixed pension contributions ($15,487,640).
